articles.title: 2 in 3 Canadians Plan Big Spending Cuts in 2026: TD Survey
articles.mainIdea: 2 in 3 Canadians Plan Big Spending Cuts in 2026: TD Survey
articles.summary: CNW Group: 2 in 3 Canadians Plan Big Spending Cuts in 2026: TD Survey. A new TD survey reveals more Canadians are kicking off 2026 with big changes to their budgets and buying habits. Two-thirds (67%) of Canadians surveyed plan to cut back their spending this year – a significant spike from 51% in 2025. Nearly six in 10 (59%) say they'll reduce their monthly budgets by up to $1,000 per month.
